text:
Sam: opened PR 612 to add an export CLI example and clarify retention UI wording. PTAL.
Priya: can you paste the sentence Legal flagged?
Sam: current line: "Admins may erase audit logs via the console." Legal wants 'erase' changed.
Legal-Review: suggest: "Admins can request deletion of exported audit records subject to customer retention and legal-hold controls." avoids implying immediate irreversible action.
Priya: updated CLI snippet to include --deidentify and --policy-id flags, and added note about exported filename pattern: export-<tenant>-<policyid>-<ts>.jsonl
Sam: also added a short note: when --deidentify is set, PII-like fields are pseudonymized using a one-way transform; see cryptographic-controls.
Legal-Review: prefer wording "one-way transform" not "non-reversible". Also asked to link retention policy API.
docs-bot: docs PR #612 passed lint and snippet-tests (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612).
Sam: thanks all — merging after test harness assertion added for the CLI example (returns 202).
